about_the_game:
Additional Beys Explode Onto the Scene! Get 14 Beys!

*DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER is scheduled to be distributed sequentially.

*Unreleased Beys cannot be used until they are distributed.

Contents:

1. BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS BONUS

2. BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.1

3. BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.2

4. BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.3

5. BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER METAL COAT

1. Grants 10,000 prize money that can be used in the in-game shop.

2. Includes 3 additional Beys!

Contents:

UMBRA SOL D 5-70TK

MIRAGE CLOCK 9-65B

TACKLE GOAT 7-70T

*This content can be used in battles within the game.

3. Includes 3 additional Beys!

*Details will be revealed at a later date.

*Planned for Dec. 2025 – Feb. 2026.

4. Includes 3 additional Beys!

*Details will be revealed at a later date.

*Planned for Jan. 2026 – Apr. 2026.

5. Includes 5 METAL COAT Beys!

*Details will be revealed at a later date.

*Planned for 2026.

*The main game text will be in English.

*All items included in the BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS are also available for individual purchase (excluding BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS BONUS). Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.

*The items included in the "BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS" are scheduled to be distributed sequentially.

*The release dates and order of distribution for each item may be subject to change.
